title: Trilobytes Extensions: Galv Weapon Proficiency + Ramza Dual Wield exp fix

posts.author: Trihan
posts.body:
Galv Weapon Proficiency fix v1.00
Trilobytes by Trihan
Introduction
This plugin was written to address a forum request, and only applies when using two plugins together:
Galv's Weapon Proficiency
and
Ramza's Dual Wield
. There is a compatibility error in the plugins as originally written where proficiency exp is only added to an actor's primary weapon, even if they're dual wielding one of a different type. This plugin fixes that.
Features
- Fixes a bug preventing all wielded weapon types from gaining proficiency exp
Screenshots
N/A
How to Use
Add this plugin below Weapon Proficiency and Dual Wield. It is an extension and will not work without the originals.
Plugin
The plugin is available from
itch.io
